notes.title: Personal life Update, I have created a new game!
notes.notes:
Hi guys, it's me Thomas.

Just a update on my life, if anyone is interested!

I'm doing well and I actually made a new game called "VR Dungeon Knight".

Some of you might remember that I did not make enough money from V ARRR, I simply could not pay the bills from it anymore.

I want to thank everyone so much who played this game. It was my first game ever and it helped me learn so much and get into the Game Industry.

I make games as a fulltime job now and it's all because of you guys! So thanks for supporting me and the game. I'm planning to make a lot more of them in the future ːsteamhappyː

If you want you can check out VR Dungeon Knight on steam, it's my new game and it's doing pretty well. I'm actually able to make a living from it.

Thanks for changing my life.
I wish you guys a great day!

-Thomas Blackjard Softworks.

notes.title: 3 New stages online featuring Sword and Pistol battles
notes.notes:
Sword and pistol battles are playable right now!

Reflect bullets, strike pirates and execute deadly crit strikes. Swordfighting is all about dodging swords, bullets and striking your enemies with your sword and pistols.

Swordfighting is a new mechanic, be sure to leave your thoughts about it!

Have a very nice weekend,

Thomas, Blackjard Softworks

notes.title: SwordFights!
notes.notes:
This week i'm working on swordfights! I will release the first levels before saturday.

If you think you are going to fight sword enemies glued to the ground, think again! 

Swordfighting gives pirates that will move around you, take space, jump in and strike! You can block their attacks and strike with your sword, the new swordfight mechanic rewards long slashes, fancy slashes, spin attacks etc etc.

The game punishes tiny quick strikes you see a lot in VR games and other motion controlled games.

You will fight on a big ship against other ships (like the main game mode).
On your ship you fight against rifle pirates and pirates with swords, they swing over to your ship and will try to defeat you in a sword battle!

Sometimes you need to fight multiple sword pirates at once!

There is a test level already online right now, It's pure a test level to see how the sword works.


Back to work!
Have a very nice day,

-Thomas, Blackjard Softworks

notes.title: Price reduction and Multiplayer CO-OP
notes.notes:
Hello!, a lot of information about V ARRR. Let's jump right in.

V ARRR is doing well and a lot of people are having a lot of fun playing it. Now that the discount period is over a lot of feedback was given in this time. 

Feedback as: Overal content, idea's, swords, co-op, and the price of the game. A lot of technical feedback was given as well and it's really helping me making V ARRR a better game.

My name is Thomas and i'm making this game all by myself, it's quite a challenge and I love working on it, even after release. I know there are some flaws in the game and also a lot of things that work great.

But over the week I have come to a decision to lower the price from 20 to 16.99 dollar/euros. Eventually it's about playing the game and making this possible for a lot of people. I did make it fair and left it above the discount price.

Now on the other hand, I have had a lot of comments requesting a 
Co-op/multiplayer mode. 

I have done multiplayer projects in the past and I know how it works. So over the coming weeks I'm going to experiment with it. I do think it's a lot of fun to shoot pirates with your friends. It's not something you just put in your game but I don't mind making a effort and give something you guys really want. So you can at least expect a Co-op mode, up to 2-4 friends fighting off ships and pirates togehter.

Next week I will release sword and pistol fights, there is a test level online already on challenge island so you can feel how the sword works.

So that's a lot of information, do leave your thoughts.
I wish you all a very nice weekend!

-Thomas, Blackjard Softworks

notes.title: First new content online, more to come next week!
notes.notes:
Challenge island has arrived and will soon be filled with all sort of new game modes and levels for you to play. It's been 3 hard working days and 5 new levels are playable right now.

All of these levels give you chests and can be played with your bought items and upgrades. 

THIS UPDATE INCLUDES: Shootouts (5 levels)

Shootouts introduces situations on land. You only have 1 life and must take out a group of pirates surrounding you. When you complete the challenge you will be rewarded. You can select these levels individually if you really like one.

----------------------------------------------------------

NEXT WEEK: Sword and Pistol survival

Sword and pistol survival will introduce swordplay, survive in these levels and fight against other pirates with swords. Slash, do spin attacks, long slashes. Swordplay encourages you to do awesome moves and punishes shaking your controller to win easy.

----------------------------------------------------------

Things that are also being added soon or fixed:

Multiple save slots.
Feature to select easy mode again when you are on hard mode.
Rifle reload fix (Rifle not moving with your hand when you reload).
New modes.
New animations.
New enemies.
More sound indications. (pirate grunts, landing sound etc)
And a other few things.

Enjoy the update, more to come soon.
And don't forget to post your idea's.

-Thomas, Blackjard Softworks

notes.title: Updates and additional content!
notes.notes:
V ARRR will have future updates, content and features.

The first updates will feature challenges. These will contain things like:

-SwordPlay.
-Shootouts.
-Time Trials.
-Survival levels.
-Challenges on land.

You can post your idea's too! Just head over to the discussions and post your idea. V ARRR is open for improvement and I would like to deliver additional and fun content.

That's all for now,
Have a nice day!
